How it goes
Fair rules
Join as a referrer
Sign in

PRIVATE JOB REFERRALS

Nobody reads the pile.

Mass applications meet software, not people. Here, one verified employee at the company you want to join reads your ask - and can open a private conversation. No commissions, no outcome promises.

Search companies
Find your company →

Explore before signing in.

skipwait.me is in beta. We're improving it every day, and your feedback shapes it.

WHAT YOU GAIN

Past the pile, into a conversation.

A verified employee inside the company picks your ask and opens a private conversation - so you arrive as a person, not one more application in the pile.

WHY NOT JUST APPLY?

Mass applying vs a referral.
MASS APPLYING
ONE REFERRAL ON SKIPWAIT.ME
Where you land

One more application in a pile, screened by software before any person.

One ask, read by a verified employee inside the company.

Your effort

The same form, re-filled for every posting, hearing nothing back.

One thoughtful ask with your resume and a short note - not another form.

Your wait

39-55 days average hiring time for job-board and career-site candidates.

About 29 days average hiring time for referred candidates.

Your odds

One of every applicant in the pile.

Referrals are about 7% of candidates and convert at nearly 40%.

THE WAIT, TO SCALE

39-55 DAYS - JOB BOARDS & CAREER SITES

ABOUT 29 DAYS - REFERRED CANDIDATES

Figures: Jobvite, “4 Reasons to Invest in Employee Referrals” - jobvite.com - Employer-side averages, not a promise for any one person.

A referral is an introduction, never a promise of an interview or a job.

HOW IT GOES

Three steps. No noise.
01
Pick where you want in

See the companies with verified employees inside, and the roles you can ask about.

02
Ask with the cost up front

You see the cost before you ask: 3 free referrals every month; extra referral requests use your balance. Every ask costs the same.

03
A yes opens a conversation

An accepted ask opens a private conversation. A referral is an introduction, never a promise of an interview or a job.

“A referral is an introduction, never a promise of an interview or a job.”

THE HONEST DEAL — ON EVERY PAGE, IN EVERY FLOW

WHY YOU CAN TRUST IT

Real insiders.
Real rules.
A real insider reads you

Every referrer proves their company email before they can see a single ask.

Private until it counts

Your name stays private until a referrer chooses to open the conversation.

Nothing spent while it waits

1 is deducted from your balance only when a verified employee can see it. The charge is refunded if you withdraw before pickup, only if its original balance or allowance has not expired, ended or been revoked and has room for the refund.

FOR EMPLOYEES

Be the way in for someone good.

Review asks when it feels right and open a door you believe in. Referring is always free - and referrers are never paid, so every yes stays genuine.

Join as a referrer

03

04

Private by default: your name stays hidden until a referrer accepts.

A warmer way in. Private job referrals from verified employees. skipwait.me is in beta.
